title: ERP-MES Printing (ISA-95)
description: Printing industry overlay for erp-mes-core: flexo press fleet, film/ink materials, Flexibase event code catalog (OGP/BM/POUCH), Zero Pull setup tags, job bag sections

changelog.notes: 1.4.2 KPI bindings on_schedule; low-roll and open downtime seed
1.4.1 seeds core 2.0 UML tables (hierarchy scope, Assembled From, product-segment specs, qualification, WM route, directive)
1.3.0 - aligned to erp-mes-core 1.4.1: roll genealogy UI/seed, Product Definition/Physical Asset/locations/schedules/capability, gen_random_uuid; requires core >=1.4.1

1.2.0: status-aware job action bar - one widget with Start/Pause/Resume/Complete buttons enabled by the selected job dispatch_status (ISA-95 state machine); requires platform with function.buttonsJson support
1.1.1: form heights calibrated to the real renderer - submit buttons no longer clipped on any operator tab
1.1.0: operator UI rework - flat dashboard widget format (no settingsJson), dropdown selects fed by catalog reports, row-click autofill into forms, KPI value cards, event journal report
Initial release: flexo printing overlay on erp-mes-core 1.0.0, certified by ErpMesPrintingOverlayTest cross-bundle scenarios
